judgment.rationale: The VCP dump proves that another tool can query the LG display but does not identify which Power Display discovery stage omitted it.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 on Windows 11 omits the monitor.
The reporter supplied a screenshot and 46 VCP capabilities.
No PowerToys diagnostic or connection topology is supplied.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a fresh report captured while the monitor is missing and the physical connection path.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted code fix would be speculative until enumeration, matching, probing, and filtering can be distinguished.

issue_context.summary: Power Display omits an LG HDR 4K display although another utility can query its DDC/CI capabilities.
known_information: The issue is on 0.101.2362.0 and Windows 11.
The supplied capability list includes brightness, contrast, input source, and power mode.
The reporter did not provide Power Display logs or connection topology.
inferences: The display may be dropped by QueryDisplayConfig/GDI matching, physical monitor enumeration, DDC probing, or hidden-monitor filtering.
issue_context.analysis: The available evidence narrows the area but cannot support an implementation-grade root cause.
initial_investigation: Reviewed DisplayConfigInventory, MonitorManager, DdcCiController, WmiController, and the no-monitors UI path.
Checked for linked fixes and duplicates; none resolves the failure stage.

information_gaps.information: Fresh PowerToys diagnostic archive captured while the display is missing.
information_gaps.why_needed: Identifies the discovery stage and rejection reason.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Open Power Display, reproduce, then immediately comment /bugreport and attach the ZIP.

information_gaps.information: Physical connection path and Windows detection state.
information_gaps.why_needed: Docks, adapters, DisplayLink, and direct connections use different enumeration paths.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: State the cable/dock/adapter path and whether Windows Settings lists the display.

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and detailed VCP capability dump. That confirms the LG display exposes DDC/CI controls, but not whether Power Display filters it during discovery or never receives it from Windows. Please reproduce the missing-monitor state, then immediately comment `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP. Also tell us whether the display is connected directly or through a dock/adapter/DisplayLink device, and whether Windows Settings > System > Display lists it.
